subject: Supply onboarding: Coupa invite redirect + OTP loop — Satori Supply
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Trouble finishing Redwood supplier setup - Satori Supply

Hi Connor,

We received the Coupa invite earlier today but when we try to complete the registration the flow gets stuck on an OTP redirect loop. The page moves from the Redwood/Coupa registration --> asks for our email OTP --> we enter it and then the site redirects back to the SSO provider and asks for OTP again. Tried three browsers and an incognito window with the same result.

Attached a screenshot (coupa-screenshot.png) and an error trace from the developer console. Our billing team is blocked — they need the vendor record created so Redwood can issue the initial PO. Can you reissue the invite or provide an alternate way to set up the vendor record?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Onboarding Lead
Satori Supply
elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing Redwood supplier setup - Satori Supply

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the screenshots. Sorry you ran into this. Two quick asks while we investigate:

- Can you try the invite link in an incognito window (I know you said you did, but sometimes SSO cookies are sticky).
- If you have a secondary contact (procurement@ or finance@), please forward the invite to them as a test.

Monica, I'm looping you in to reissue the invitation from Coupa and see if we can generate a one-off manual registration link (Coupa has a bypass token we can issue). If the portal is redirecting to their IdP repeatedly, we may need to create a temporary supplier record on our side so we can send a PO while Coupa is fixed.

Elena — we can also accept a signed W9 and invoice PDF directly and create a temp supplier id. If you can send the W9 to procurement@redwood.com I'll make sure it gets routed.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing Redwood supplier setup - Satori Supply

Elena — I reissued a fresh invite from Coupa (token regenerates). You should have a new email with subject "Redwood Inference — Supplier Onboarding Invite". I also attached a short PO template and seeded the required fields so your billing team can preview. If the SSO redirect still occurs, please send the W9 to procurement@redwood.com and I'll create a temporary supplier record for PO issuance.

Attachments: Satori_W9_Signed.pdf (please confirm receipt) , PO-template.docx

If the new invite fails I can open a ticket with our Coupa admin — sharing the portal trace will help (thanks for capturing it).

- Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing Redwood supplier setup - Satori Supply

Monica — we got the new invite but it's still redirecting to our IdP and looping on OTP. I attached the console trace (error_trace.txt) showing repeated 302s to https://idp.satorisupply.com/saml/SSO and then back to Coupa. Our IT says it looks like Coupa is dropping the RelayState on the first OTP submission which causes the IdP to return to the login step.

Can Redwood create the supplier record manually so you can issue the initial PO to invoices@satorisupply.com? We're happy to email a signed W9 and a copy of our company registration to procurement@redwood.com.

Thanks for the fast help — this is blocking the first invoice.

Elena
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@satorisupply.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Trouble finishing Redwood supplier setup - Satori Supply

Following up with an update: I escalated the trace to our Coupa admin and they confirmed a platform-side issue with RelayState handling for certain SSO configurations; they're working with Coupa support now.

In the meantime Monica created a temporary supplier record so Treasury can issue a PO. I've attached the temp supplier id file and a preview of the PO we will send (PO-000432-preview.pdf).

Next steps for Elena / Satori Supply:
- Please send the signed W9 and remit instructions to procurement@redwood.com (we received Satori_W9_Signed.pdf — thank you).
- Confirm invoice destination (invoices@satorisupply.com) and VAT/GST details if applicable.

Monica / Laura: please confirm once PO is issued and if Coupa support provides a fix we should reopen the Coupa invite so the supplier record is permanent.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachments: supplier-temp-record-6321.txt, PO-000432-preview.pdf
